title: Marine told Tucker Carlson about a mysterious creature allegedly killed in Afghanistan by US troops, then said where the body supposedly went
excerpt: He claimed an incident from 2002 proved that giants roam the earth.

He claimed an incident from 2002 proved that giants roam the earth.

Jordan Collins

|

Published: Nov 11, 2026 06:45 pm

A former U.S. Marine has suggested that the Smithsonian has kept evidence of the existence of giants under wraps. Appearing as a guest on the Tucker Carlson Show, Chad Robichaux claimed that soldiers in Afghanistan had shot and killed a giant in the 2000s before the humanoid creature’s body was supposedly transported back to the U.S.

Robichaux appeared on an episode of the former Fox News host’s show that was posted to YouTube on November 6. A portion of the episode saw the pair discuss the possibility of the existence of giants, with Robichaux claiming he believed modern-day accounts of giants too, bringing up “the giant of Kandahar,” which Carlson explained allegedly took place in Afghanistan.

The giant of Kandahar refers to an incident, or conspiracy theory, that supposedly occurred in 2002, in which U.S. soldiers in Afghanistan were attacked by a giant red-haired humanoid, which the troops subsequently shot and killed. Robichaux explained that a team of Marines went searching for missing Marines before allegedly encountering the creature.

“A team went back to go in and see what happened with these Marines, and they ended up getting in a gunfight and killing this giant,” Robichaux claimed. The former Marine also told Carlson that he wholeheartedly believed the story of the giant of Kandahar, although he admitted that he had never seen a giant during his eight deployments in the country.

The giant was supposedly transported to the Smithsonian

When Carlson pressed Robichaux over the physical evidence of giants, such as the ones depicted in the Bible, the former marine claimed that all of the proof that giants are real “goes to the Smithsonian and never to be seen again.”

Claims that the Smithsonian have hidden, or even destroyed, the remains of giants have been made in the past. According to Reuters, the claims are thought to be either fake or satirical.

Regardless, Robichaux claimed that the body of the giant of Kandahar was then flown back to the United States following the incident in Afghanistan. “This giant was flown back to the United States by a US Air Force aircraft. I think it was a C-17 aircraft, if I remember correctly,” he told Carlson. However, no public record of such an event has ever been released.

However, he claimed that first-hand testimony from the pilot who flew the body back to the U.S. convinced him that the story was true. “I’ve had a personal conversation with Tim Alberino, who interviewed the pilot,” he said. He went on to add that the pilot hadn’t publicly confirmed the story but that Alberino had. “For him to tell me that he had this interview, a personal interview with the pilot that flew this giant out. I believe him.”
